data.long_meaning: Stephanie is derived from the Greek name 'Stephanos', meaning 'crown'. In ancient Greece, a wreath or crown was given as a symbol of honor. In the Bible, the name Stephen is used for a deacon and a martyr, further emphasizing the idea of honor and distinction. The name Stephie carries the meaning “Crown of flowers” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Stephie usually hope their child will grow to embody crown of flowers and live with faith, good character and purpose.
